name: Authenticated event intake and normalization
trigger: Webhook, scheduled poll or human request

steps.action: Verify signature, timestamp, origin and schema
Resolve client and authoritative object references
Apply payload size and secret/PII minimization

acceptance_tests: Forged, stale or wrong-client webhook rejected
Duplicate delivery acknowledged without duplicate action
failure: Reject or HOLD the event/action, keep a redacted durable receipt, use bounded retries only for retry-safe failures, and send unresolved or ambiguous outcomes to human reconciliation.

run_contract.owner: Assigned accountable role in OpenProject before activation
run_contract.retry: Bounded retry only after retryability classification; unknown remote effects HOLD
run_contract.observability: workflow_id, run_id, correlation_id, state and redacted error; no raw PII labels
run_contract.recovery: Restore HOLD; reapply suppression/deletion and reconcile external receipts before replay
run_contract.completion: Named output plus acceptance evidence, not merely a running service
